text: A02 instantiate (215) read whole in three packets, with the G1b draws at verb offsets 298, 398 and 498 (100, 100 and 15 lines; 30 drawn; every drawn how agrees with its quotes); about 70 more quotes read to tell a start already made from a joint opening. Rulings built from a spec with one evidence line per id (A02-inst-spec.txt, d3_arrow_inst_rulings.py, which checks every id against the packets): the order shown, 104 (a start before the call, or a call naming a start already made: 'I've started the upper rays at 824,913', NewMexico; "I'm making a she slime", dragonquest); a joint opening followed by a later call around the mark, 37 (monstercat, timbers, chelseafc); a lone joint opening, 59 ('let's draw a monokuma on r/place', danganronpa; "Let's do a Cubs logo on r/place Who's in?", chicubs); the bound, a bare call naming no mark before the proposal, 8 (49ers, 4chan, kuwait, unitedkingdom, yugioh); one end only, 4; other, 3 (a successor canvas, kirby; credits after the close, ireland; a call to help another room's hearts, wholesomememes). Accept 141, reject 74. The joint opening is the commonest form the labelers name: the proposal and the call are one post. G33 counts it apart and rejects it alone. Reading kept for G33: a proposal put as a question to the room ('Should we...?', 'Could we...?') is a joint opening, as G10 read a call that names its picture

G33's amendment logged in notes-D3.md (D3a-28, after the instantiate lines were ruled and the 134 restrict lines read, before any restrict line was ruled; applies to A02's restrict lines and forward, not backwards): G33's sentence that a restriction held by the connection, mechanism or bound 'is a specification' is read with G9's reclassification by concepts: specification where the concepts show the order, a joint opening with a later call, or the bound's pattern; evidence limit (kind none) where they show only a joint opening; not a correction, because a lone joint opening neither meets the order nor A02's mechanism_fails_if. A restriction whose concepts show a start drawing helpers with no call meets the falsifier and is ruled by G9 as a correction. Reason: the restrict lines nearly all say that the start and the call can be one post; ruling those as specifications would count as A02 shown the same pattern that G33 rejects in instantiate lines

A02 restrict (134) read whole (29 more quotes read, 15 of them checking whether a 'starting X' label hides 'let's start X'): rulings built from a spec with one evidence line per id (A02-restrict-spec.txt, d3_arrow_restrict_rulings.py, checked against the packets): specification 55 (the order shown 31, a joint opening with a later call 20, the bound's reverse order 4), evidence limit 77 (only a joint opening, or no order readable: "Let's start an English flag", england; "i'm gonna start building", pcmasterrace), particular 2 (criticalrole-034: 'I started that on my own, apparently people understood what I was going for ... and we managed to get it done', a start drawing helpers with no call, which meets A02's falsifier, no second room meeting it; marvel-039, G6). No accepted correction, so section 2 is not triggered. The same quote check corrected three label-only readings: sweden-036 (instantiate, 'Jag börjar med en blå plupp och sen följer ni efter', an instruction given with the call) from the order to a joint opening, rebuilt as A02-inst-v2.jsonl (A02-inst.jsonl stays, unused); uoft-005 and portal-008 (restrict) read as joint openings. Present-tense starts ('I'm starting on Spock', 'Starting on Sora's Sprite') count as starts under way, as 'I'm making a she slime' did. Instantiate now: the order 103, joint with a later call 37, lone joint 60, the bound 8, one end 4, other 3; accept 140, reject 75
